snippet.title: Rift Miner - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3989120/Rift_Miner/

👻 Roguelite
🕒 Time Management
🕹 Arcade
🏅 Score Attack
👻 Roguelike

Rift Miner is First-Person-Mining-Roguelite: mine resources against the clock, escape through the portal, and invest your haul in permanent upgrades. Unlock Echo Cards for powerful synergies. Brave the high-risk Deeper Rifts for even greater rewards.
